fields.acceptance_criteria: spec update_body rejects empty content unless an explicit force flag is set; update_body rejects content byte-identical to the existing body as a no-op error; both rejections return actionable error messages distinguishing empty from no-op; a successful update_body guarantees the stored body changed; unit tests cover empty-rejected, empty-forced, no-op-rejected, and normal-update paths; rejection surfaces through the MCP spec update tool and CLI
fields.title: [spec-api] Reject empty and no-op spec body updates so a successful update guarantees a change
